card.name: Inside thalidomide and thalamus words
card.fires_on: The piece "al" right after "Th" in thalidomide, thalassemia and thalami. Weaker on a few other split word starts such as "Scribb|ly" and "STR|IB|ILD".

modes.label: Th-al words
modes.description: The "al" piece after "Th" in thalidomide, thalassemia or thalami.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Occasional piece inside an unusual split name, such as a brand name or a gum tree name.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the word thalidomide and related words like thalassemia.
